map.输入工作年限与解除前十二个月平均工资，依据《劳动合同法》第40条计算“N+1”解: Enter years of service and the average wage over the twelve months before termination, and compute the 'N+1' severance amount for contract termination under Article 40 of the Labour Contract Law, helping workers work out what they are owed.
map.填写「当地社平工资3倍（元/月）」。: Fill in '3 times local average wage (CNY/month)'.
map.填写「是否提前30天通知」。: Fill in 'whether 30 days advance notice was given'.
map.用人单位无过失性辞退且未提前 30 日书面通知，测算 N+1 补偿总额。: When an employer dismisses without fault and without 30 days written notice, estimate the total N+1 compensation.
map.N 按工作年限（满半年不满 1 年按 1 年）确定，再加 1 个月代通知金。: N is set by years of service (at least half a year but under 1 year counts as 1 year), plus 1 month of payment in lieu of notice.
map.高薪者基数按社平 3 倍封顶、年限最高 12 年。: For high earners the base is capped at 3 times the local average wage and years at 12.
map.工作 8 年、月薪 1.5 万、未提前通知: 8 years of service, monthly salary 15,000, no advance notice
map.：N = 8，经济补偿 = 15000 × 8 = 120,000 元；代通知金: : N = 8, severance = 15000 × 8 = 120,000 CNY; payment in lieu of notice = 15,000 CNY; N+1 total 135,000 CNY.
map.：工作 20 年、月薪超社平 3 倍（基数封顶 3.5 万）：N 封顶 12，经: : 20 years of service, monthly salary above 3 times the local average (base capped at 35,000): N capped at 12, severance = 35000 × 12 = 420,000 CNY, plus 35,000 payment in lieu = 455,000 CNY.
map.N+1 对应合法无过失辞退且未提前通知；2N 对应违法解除。性质不同，不能叠加。: N+1 corresponds to lawful no-fault dismissal without advance notice; 2N corresponds to unlawful termination. They differ in nature and cannot be stacked.
map.代通知金按什么工资算？: What wage is payment in lieu of notice based on?
map.按劳动者上一个月的工资标准；若上一个月工资不能反映正常水平，可参照解除前十二个月: Based on the worker's wage for the previous month; if that does not reflect the normal level, use the average wage over the twelve months before termination.
